title: Two new ways to turn ideas and videos into finished stories
summary:
A community-heavy day: new story and transcript tools, more dependable chat controls, and less drama around large images and deployments.

The writing collection gained StoryCraft AI for generating multi-chapter illustrated storybooks, plus MrPaloma's YouTube Transcription AI for turning video transcripts into structured notes, translations, and concept-cover ideas. Men's Fashion Pins also joined the image apps, making polished Pinterest artwork a slightly more specialized solved problem.

Explicit token limits, tool-call settings, and supported top_k options now reach the chat gateway without defaults quietly rewriting the request. The gateway update also improves support for Azure parallel tools and Claude effort, JSON-schema, and output settings.

Bloom 0.1.3 users can now enable, inspect, or remove a dedicated Pollinations key through `polli harness bloom`, without turning their existing `.env` file into configuration compost.

highlights.title: StoryCraft AI
highlights.text: Turn an idea into a multi-chapter illustrated storybook, with Pollinations handling the words and scene art. [Try it](https://khushalkks.github.io/pollinations)

highlights.title: Men’s Fashion Pins
highlights.text: Generate polished Pinterest artwork for men’s fashion with `gpt-image-2`. Pocket squares now have an API. [Try it](https://fashionpins4u.blogspot.com/p/mens-fashion-pins.html)

highlights.title: YouTube Transcription AI
highlights.text: Turn YouTube transcripts into structured summaries, English translations, and concept-cover images. [Try it](https://www.mrpaloma.com/trascrivere-video-youtube-pollinations)

highlights.title: Bloom harness for Polli CLI
highlights.text: Connect Bloom CLI to Pollinations text models with `polli harness bloom on`, then inspect or remove the setup without disturbing the rest of your `.env`.
